questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.topic: Interest rate as the rental price of capital
questions.learningObjective: Explain interest rate as rental price
questions.stem: A clinician's note asks why the interest rate is called the rental price of capital; explain.

answer.exemplar: Borrowing capital for a period costs interest, just as renting an asset costs a fee, so the rate is the rental price.

questions.explanation: Interest is the price of using capital over time. The wrong view treats interest as a fixed fee unrelated to time.
